svg.title: Legacy CANOE transportation model
svg.desc: Wide overview of imported fuels, endogenous hydrogen and separate demands by vehicle and mode class. Original technology counts are retained. Hourly charger load is annotated only for light-duty BEVs. Node-type parameters form a compact legend at bottom left.
